hero.title: Build your resume in
hero.subtitle: ResuMate is Cambodia's AI powered career readiness platform. Build a professional resume, analyze any job ad, match your skills to the role, and prepare for your interview all in one place.

features.title: Everything you need to get
features.subtitle: 11 AI powered features designed specifically for Cambodian fresh graduates and job seekers.

items.title: Step by step builder
items.desc: No blank page. No confusion. Guided through every section one at a time.

items.title: AI design picker
items.desc: Answer 3 questions or describe your vibe. AI picks the best layout, color, and font for your industry.

items.title: AI writing assistant
items.desc: Type in simple words  AI rewrites it into professional English with action verbs.

items.title: Live split screen
items.desc: See your resume updating in real time as you type. Always know what it looks like.

items.title: Resume score
items.desc: Get a 0 to 100% score with a checklist showing exactly what to improve before you apply.

items.title: PDF export A4
items.desc: One click clean A4 PDF. Cambodia standard. No watermarks on free plan.

items.title: Job ad analysis
items.desc: Paste any Cambodian job posting. AI extracts every requirement, skill, and qualification.

items.title: Resume match engine
items.desc: Compares your resume to the job ad and calculates a match score with gap analysis.

items.title: Improvement suggestions
items.desc: Personalized, specific recommendations to improve your resume for the target role.

items.title: Interview prep
items.desc: Questions based on your actual resume AND the job ad  not generic questions.

items.title: Job readiness report
items.desc: The full picture your readiness score, strengths, gaps, and a clear action plan before you submit your application. Combines your resume analysis, job match results, and interview preparation into one comprehensive assessment.

steps.title: Job ready in
steps.subtitle: From building your resume to knowing if you're ready to apply all in one place.

items.title: Pick your template
items.desc: 10 templates across 5 Cambodian industries. Or let AI pick based on your vibe.

items.title: Fill in your info
items.desc: One section at a time. AI rewrites your words into professional English instantly.

items.title: Check your score
items.desc: 0–100% resume strength. Fix missing items. Download as A4 PDF.

items.title: Paste a job ad
items.desc: Copy any posting from LinkedIn, CamHR, or BongThom. AI extracts all requirements.

items.title: See your match
items.desc: Match score, missing skills, and qualification gaps between your resume and the job.

items.title: Improve & prepare
items.desc: Personalized resume fixes + interview questions specific to the role you're targeting.

items.title: Get your readiness report
items.desc: Your final score are you ready to apply? A clear action plan if you're not.
